Keywords.Hold the Line: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to morale test rolls triggered by shooting/melee.
Keywords.Agile: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.
Keywords.Caster Group: Pick one model with this rule in this unit to have Caster(X), where X is the total number of models with this rule in this unit.
Keywords.Crack: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+2).
Keywords.Furious: Whenever this unit charges, it gets +1 to hit in melee.
Keywords.Tough(X): This model must take X wounds before being killed.

Human Empire Spells.Aura of Heroism (1): Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Hold the Line Boost once (next time the effect would apply).
Human Empire Spells.Fire Ball (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(1) and Crack.
Human Empire Spells.Magic Targeting (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 18", which friendly units get +1 to hit rolls in melee against once.
Human Empire Spells.Blood Hex (2): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 6 hits.
Human Empire Spells.Elemental Form (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get AP(+1) in melee once.
Human Empire Spells.Spirit Leech (3): Pick one enemy model within 18", which takes 6 hits with AP(1). Resolved as if target was a unit of [1].
